title: Location with está
explanation: Use está to say where a place is: La estación está cerca. Use es to identify what something is: Es un hotel. This module only contrasts these fixed uses.

title: ¿Dónde está...?
explanation: Use ¿Dónde está...? to ask where a place is. The answer should locate the place, not give transport.

title: ¿Cómo llego...? and ¿Cómo voy...?
explanation: Use ¿Cómo llego a...? to ask how to get somewhere. Use ¿Cómo voy a...? to ask how to travel there. These are route questions, not location answers.

title: Simple route directions
explanation: Use the fixed directions Sigue recto, Gira a la izquierda and Gira a la derecha. In route-sequence tasks, order matters.

title: cerca and lejos
explanation: Use cerca for near and lejos for far. With a place, use está: La farmacia está cerca.

title: Transport method patterns
explanation: Use Voy en... for bus, train, metro, taxi, car and bicycle. Use Voy a pie for on foot. For advice, use Toma el metro or Ve en autobús as fixed A0 phrases.
